K5 (b) u(vtol) - u(vguard) in correlated damage, 4 x 4, sigma 0

dropped.name: K1 sheet cost under scattered cue damage: r_all(vote) - r_all(vtol), cue@0
dropped.why: the confirmed bound 0.01, as planned; on P57 +0.008713 (sd_block 0.002786, halves +0.009705, +0.007721), margin 0.46 against the rule's 1.68: P57 cannot support it; not registered (the lead's ruling (a) at phase A), reported at the development with its 95% interval beside the confirmed 0.01

statements.claim: with no event its false alarms cost intact tissue within the confirmed bound, and under misreads within AR003's E9 bound
statements.rule: HOLDS if r_all(vote) - r_all(vtol) in none@0 <= 0.002 and r_all(vote, none@0) - r_all(vtol, none@1) <= 0.01, else FAILS

statements.claim: under misread cues it keeps the pooled detector's recovery over the confirmed controller
statements.rule: HOLDS if R1 = (1/2) sum over sizes 4, 8 of u(vtol, memory@1) - u(vms, memory@1) >= 0.04 and R1(vtol) - 0.5 R1(vpool) >= 0.0, else FAILS

statements.claim: at sigma 0 it keeps the confirmed controller's hits (non-inferiority)
statements.rule: HOLDS if R0 = (1/2) sum over sizes 4, 8 of u(vtol, memory@0) - u(vms, memory@0) >= -0.005, else FAILS

statements.claim: the blind spot resolved: where body and record share the error it is not worse than the confirmed controller, and it gains over the fully guarded one
statements.rule: HOLDS if in correlated damage at 4 x 4 u(vtol) - u(vms) >= -0.005 and u(vtol) - u(vguard) >= 0.25 at sigma 0, and u(vtol) - u(vms) >= -0.03 and u(vtol) - u(vguard) >= 0.0 at sigma 1, else FAILS

statements.claim: under misread cues the controller still beats the best fixed policy
statements.rule: HOLDS if W1 = (1/2) sum over sizes 4, 8 of u(vtol, memory@1) - u(vote, memory@0) >= 0.12, else FAILS

statements.claim: it gives up nothing to the vote with no event, with or without misread cues (non-inferiority)
statements.rule: HOLDS if u(vtol) - u(vote) in the 4 x 4 patch is at least -0.005 in none@0, and u(vtol, none@1) - u(vote, none@0) >= -0.005, else FAILS
